command:
# Stage the first COUNT runs of the recorded G3 cohort (results/cohort/PRJNA398089/runs.tsv,
# #25) from ENA into the in-region bucket, md5-checked: make stage-cohort, run on an instance
# because ENA to the launch host runs at about 50-260 KB/s. The script and the cohort record come
# from the launch commit. Afterwards, from the launch host: commit out/staged.tsv as
# results/cohort/PRJNA398089/staged.tsv, and make tag-objects PREFIX=aws-kraken2/data/cohort/
# (the instance role cannot tag).
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
COUNT=10
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git jq tar gzip > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA; nproc $(nproc); disk $(df -h "$W" | tail -1 | tr -s ' ')"
ak2_phase stage
(cd "$W/repo" && scripts/stage-cohort.sh stage PRJNA398089 "$COUNT") > "$W/stage.log" 2>&1
RC=$?
cat "$W/stage.log"
ak2_req GetObject-ENA "$((COUNT * 2))" ""
ak2_req PutObject "$(grep -c ' staged (' "$W/stage.log")" "${AK2_BUCKETS%% *}"
ak2_phase push
ak2_push "$W/stage.log" stage.log
[ -s "$W/repo/results/cohort/PRJNA398089/staged.tsv" ] && ak2_push "$W/repo/results/cohort/PRJNA398089/staged.tsv" staged.tsv
ak2_say "stage-cohort rc=$RC"
exit "$RC"
